product_description: Solid Khaya (African mahogany) electric guitar in headless and headed series, with conventional passive electronics. A performance instrument, amplified through the output jack. Onboard compute was dropped on 2026-07-27 and is deferred, not abandoned.

construction.body_architecture_note: Solid Khaya blank with routed cavities. Cavity placement is materially harder than in the hollow sibling: each pocket needs wall thickness to its neighbours, which is what forces the reduced electronics package.

series.note: Shares the headless bridge and locking nut with the Smart Guitar.

Flying V profile headstock with 6-inline locking tuners for straight string pull. Adds roughly 190 mm of overall length and replaces the headless bridge tuners with conventional ones. Body, neck, and cavities are otherwise identical to the headless series.

components: Dual pickups, type fluid — see CONF-PICKUP-TYPE
Passive volume, tone and selector in the control cavity
electronics_package.rationale: Onboard compute dropped 2026-07-27. A solid body cannot host both the Pi pocket and the audio front-end pocket — only one site in the body is large enough for either, and the result held at wall 6 mm, rim 10 mm, voids -10% and body +10% (CONF-SOLID-BODY-PACKING). Rather than shrink the compute or abandon solid construction, this line reverts to a conventional passive instrument. That is not a loss: it decouples the Khaya from the front-end board's schedule and certification entirely, so it ships on wood and hardware alone.
electronics_package.open_question: DEFERRED, NOT CLOSED. Smart features may return to this line via a companion unit rather than onboard, or via a body design that creates the space — chambering, a different cavity arrangement, or a revised outline. Those options are unexplored. What is settled is that the CURRENT solid body with the CURRENT electronics stack cannot carry both pockets.

provenance.note: Split from a single conflated product record on 2026-07-27. This line carries BOTH headstock series; the Smart Guitar line is headless only.

notes: STATUS IS 'concept'. Like its sibling, this instrument exists as an AI-generated image and a set of derived dimensions, not as a measured object.
This line no longer depends on the audio front-end board, so it is not blocked by that board's design, NRE or certification. It was the argument for dropping compute and it is the main benefit.

The packing evidence, retained so the decision is not revisited from scratch: POD_PI 93 x 64 has 10 valid sites and POD_HAT 73 x 64.5 has 18, all in the same region; Pi + battery fits, board + battery fits, Pi + board does not; the largest pocket that fits anywhere is 100 x 60. An earlier area budget suggested 123 cm2 spare and was wrong — area parity does not prove a packing.
The headed series is concept_defined and gated behind the headless first article, so its extra hardware is a documented delta rather than a costed variant.
Contains no cost, price, or margin fields by design.

SOURCING POLICY — NO EMBEDDED THIRD-PARTY CONSUMER PRODUCTS. A finished retail product may not be designed into either instrument as an internal component. Embedding one creates OEM licensing and trademark exposure, a single-source dependency on another company's product roadmap, warranty and support ambiguity, and re-certification questions for the finished assembly. This rules out mounting an iRig HD 2, Apogee Jam X, Scarlett Solo or MOTU M2 inside the body, regardless of whether it physically fits. EXTERNAL peripherals are NOT affected: shipping or recommending an interface the customer connects is resale, not embedding.
